context: Hero section reorganization for the GOLDEN PIRATES alliance recruitment portal (Kingdom 1023, Call of Dragons). Eliminates sticker clutter and scattered badges to deliver a highly strategic, 100% pirate visual hierarchy where the October season countdown serves as the 'secret weapon' focal point for visitors, recruits, and administrators.
theme: Dark Pirate War Room (#06090E ink, burnished gold #D4AF37, parchment bone #E8D8C8, blood red #B91C1C)

hierarchy.hero_subtitle: text-base sm:text-lg md:text-xl font-fell italic text-bone/90 max-w-xl mx-auto leading-relaxed
hierarchy.command_badge: font-mono text-[10px] sm:text-xs tracking-[0.25em] uppercase text-gold
hierarchy.cta_button: font-display text-lg sm:text-xl tracking-widest uppercase px-8 sm:px-10 py-3.5 sm:py-4 transition-all duration-300

visual_enhancers.embers: floating ambient gold particles rising from the countdown weapon plate
visual_enhancers.compass_rose: subtle rotatable 3D compass rose background element responding to mouse hover perspective

grids_and_layouts.hero_structure: Centrally orchestrated single-column War Room hero (max-w-5xl) eliminating sticker clutter. 5-Stage Strategic Hierarchy: Stage 1 (Tactical Status Command Ribbon) -> Stage 2 (Dominant GOLDEN PIRATES Title) -> Stage 3 (Evocative Lore Subtitle) -> Stage 4 (The Secret Weapon: Illuminated Countdown Relic) -> Stage 5 (Strategic CTAs & Ticker Bar).
grids_and_layouts.countdown_relic_layout: Horizontal framed brass-and-wood chest plate containing 4 tabular countdown blocks (JOURS / HEURES / MIN / SEC) with real-time flip motion, an animated burning fuse bar, and active ember sparks.

motion.entrance: Framer Motion staggered reveal with smooth cubic-bezier easing [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]
motion.parallax_bg: Scroll-based background y-translation and subtle zoom scale
motion.digit_flip: AnimatePresence y-axis slice transition for per-second digit updates
motion.fuse_burn: Dynamic percentage progress line with glowing flame icon and rising ember particles

accessibility.contrast: APCA high-contrast compliance with bone/gold text over deep ink background
accessibility.test_ids: Every key element MUST retain data-testid attributes: hero-section, hero-badge-kvk, hero-title, hero-subtitle, hero-countdown-wrap, hero-countdown, hero-cta-apply, hero-cta-track, hero-scroll-cue
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect user prefers-reduced-motion settings by dampening parallax and flame animations

media.compass_svg: Embedded precision SVG Compass Rose component with cardinal points and gold/blood red accents

instructions_to_main_agent: Reorganize Hero.jsx to eliminate scattered sticker/badge bloat. Replace the multiple separate badges with a single unified 'Command Ribbon' at the top containing kingdom & season status with a pulsing blood red indicator.
Promote the Countdown timer in Hero.jsx as the undeniable 'Secret Weapon' focal point: frame it inside an elegant pirate relic plate with glowing embers and burning fuse.
Center align the main Hero text column to create a majestic, balanced, cinematic focal point.
Ensure all data-testid attributes are strictly preserved for test automation compatibility.
Maintain backward compatibility for the compact Countdown variants (`variant='line'`) used in forms and recruit tracking views.
Follow JS format (React .jsx files) as specified in project structure.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop: Avoid generic centered white/gray SaaS designs. Maintain deep immersive pirate storytelling with rich textures, gold accents, gothic typography, and atmospheric lighting.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous vertical breathing room between section elements (py-16 to py-24).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Never use transition: all. Specify individual properties like transform, opacity, background-color.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.interactive_contrast: Ensure buttons and links have distinct hover states with glow/shadow effects and high contrast text.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
